page.title: Bible AR
page.intro: Step into Scripture through image recognition and 3D interaction, meeting Bible characters in the space before you.
page.empty: No AR experiences are available yet.

experience.title: How It Works
experience.description: Follow these steps to launch the AR experience and watch Bible characters appear from the card in front of you.

steps.title: Prepare the card
steps.description: Have your Bible character card ready and make sure the printed image is clear and unobstructed.

steps.title: Start AR
steps.description: Tap the start button to enter AR scanning mode.

steps.title: Allow camera access
steps.description: Grant camera permission when prompted so the experience can recognize the card.

steps.title: Point at the card
steps.description: Hold your camera steadily over the card and wait for the image to be recognized.

steps.title: Explore the story
steps.description: Once the 3D Bible character appears, interact and continue exploring the story.
